passives.name: Plasma Oscillations
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Right after all attacks, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response. When hit by a single-target attack, final damage is reduced by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_514], and Weakness Gauge damage is not taken. Additionally, Weakness Gauge is recovered by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_513]. (Only the highest final damage reduction value applies.) When an Enemy uses a skill that is not an attack, they take [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_515] Fixed Damage twice. Each time an Enemy takes an action other than Burst Skill/Dual Attack/Skill Chain, all Dark Enemies’ damage increases by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_516_child]. The Action Point cost for non-Dark Enemies increases by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_517]. TheCursed/Fixed Damage the boss receives cannot exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3]. All attacks deal more damage the fewer targets there are.
